answer: Fingerprint escrow stops forgery. Agents lock a 500-credit deposit unlocking through stepped terrace tiers as a work fingerprint builds. That fingerprint is a cipher. A forged clone starts blank and must replay weeks of real history. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits plus 100 fabricated histories, linear per clone; honest agents pay once. The zenith tier stays for proven identities, while fakers face sunk costs no script automates away.
